grid_sensitivity.description: Common-realization input/grid sensitivity, not a spatial-convergence certificate. N8 source and capacity are conservative block means of the same N16 native snapshot; unresolved input substructure changes with resolution.
grid_sensitivity.restriction: N16 xHI is atom-weighted onto N8; native brightness is volume-averaged onto N8. Each power spectrum uses its own mean subtraction, identical N8 FFT geometry and no mean matching.
